#| label:  setup

library(factoextra)
library(corrplot)
source('https://inkaverse.com/setup.r')

# Research Objective

> https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Us3b4buA-tXxltZd1kd970NttFA4k_apQvLdQ8BXXTw/edit?gid=543463494#gid=543463494

# Data import

- Data morfológica curada de los maíces amiláceos Peruanos de Grobman et al (1961). 

- Select variables with more than 80% of data.

```{r}
url <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Us3b4buA-tXxltZd1kd970NttFA4k_apQvLdQ8BXXTw/edit?gid=37859623#gid=37859623"

gs <- url %>% 
  as_sheets_id()

rawdata <- gs %>% 
  range_read("STable1")
rawdata %>% dim()
rawdata %>% str()

fb <- rawdata %>% 
  dplyr::select(where(~ mean(!is.na(.x)) >= 0.8)) %>% 
  rename_with(~ tolower(gsub(" ", "_", .x))) %>% 
  rename_with(~ tolower(gsub("\\(|\\)", "", .x))) %>% 
  mutate(across(1:plant_pubescence, ~ as.character(.))) %>% 
  mutate(across(1:plant_pubescence, ~ as.factor(.))) 
fb %>% dim()

cat("Variables with more 80% of data: ", ncol(fb))

fb %>% str()

web_table(fb, caption = "Data with variables with more than 80% data")
```

# Summary data

```{r}
smr <- fb %>% 
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), list(mean = ~ mean(x = ., na.rm = T)
                                           , sd = ~ sd(x = ., na.rm = T)
                                           , min = ~ min(x = ., na.rm = T)
                                           , max = ~ max(x = ., na.rm = T)))) %>% 
  rowid_to_column() %>% 
  pivot_longer(!rowid) %>% 
  separate(name, c("trait", "stat"), sep = "_(?=[^_]+$)") %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = stat, values_from = value) %>% 
  dplyr::select(!c(rowid))
  
smr %>% kable()

smr |> write_sheet(ss = gs, sheet = "STable2")
```

## RO 1

```{r}
dtx <- fb

# str(dtx)
  
mv <- dtx %>% 
  column_to_rownames("race") %>% 
  mutate(across(1:4, ~ as.factor(.))) %>% 
  PCA(X = ., scale.unit = T, graph = F, quali.sup = c(1:5))

pcainfo <- factoextra::get_pca(mv); pcainfo

pcainfo$cor %>% kable(caption = "Variable correlations")
pcainfo$contrib %>% kable(caption = "Variable Contribution")
pcainfo$cos2 %>% kable(caption = "Variable Cos2")

var <- fviz_pca_var(mv, col.var = "cos2",
             gradient.cols = c("#7570b3", "#d95f02", "#e7298a", "#1b9e77", "#66a61e"), 
             repel = TRUE,
             labelsize = 2)

var

ind <- plot.PCA(mv, choix = c("ind")
                , cex = 0.8
                , label = "ind"
                , invisible = "quali"
                , habillage = 1
                )  +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",       # leyenda abajo
    legend.direction = "horizontal"   # en una sola línea
  ) + guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1))

ind

cls <- HCPC(mv, graph = F)

clsp <- \() {
  
  plot.HCPC(cls, choice = "map", nb.clust=-1, draw.tree = F)
  
}

cos2p <- ~ {
  
pcainfo$cos2[, 1:2] %>% 
  corrplot(
    is.corr = F
    , method = "number",
    type = "full",
    
    # Texto
    tl.col = "black",
    tl.srt = 45,          # mejor legibilidad
    tl.cex = 0.6,         # etiquetas más visibles
    
    # Números
    number.cex = 0.5,     # mayor tamaño
    number.digits = 1,    # control de precisión
    
    # Barra de color
    cl.cex = 0.7,
    cl.pos = "r",
    cl.align = "r",
    cl.ratio = 4        # evita que la barra comprima la figura
  )

}

grid <- list(ind, clsp) %>% 
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 1) %>% 
  plot_grid(., cos2p, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(1.8, 1))

grid

plot <- grid %>% 
  ggsave(plot = ., "manuscript/Figure-1.jpg", units = "cm"
                , width = 25, height = 25)

plot %>% include_graphics()

cos2_selvar <- pcainfo$cos2[, 1:2] %>% 
  data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column(var = "variable") %>% 
  filter(if_any(c(Dim.1, Dim.2), ~ . > 0.6))

cos2_selvar %>% kable(caption = "Selected variables with Cos2 > 0.6")

selvar <- cos2_selvar %>% 
  dplyr::select(variable) %>% 
  deframe()
```

# PCA

```{r}
dtx <- fb

# str(dtx)
  
mv <- PCA(X = dtx, scale.unit = T, graph = F)

fviz_pca_var(mv, col.var = "cos2",
             gradient.cols = c("#7570b3",  "#d95f02", "#e7298a", "#1b9e77", "#66a61e"), 
             repel = TRUE
             )

var <- plot.PCA(mv, choix = c("var"), cex=0.7, )

ind <- plot.PCA(mv, choix = c("ind")
                , cex = 0.5
                , label = "ind"
                , invisible = "quali"
                )

plot <- list(var, ind) %>% 
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 2, labels = "auto") %>% 
  ggsave(plot = ., "manuscript/PCA.jpg", units = "cm"
                , width = 30, height = 15)

plot %>% include_graphics()

pcainfo <- factoextra::get_pca(mv)

sink("files/pca.txt")
cat("\nPrincipal Component Analysis Results\n")
summary(mv, nbelements = Inf, nb.dec = 2)
cat("\nCorrelations between variables and dimensions\n")
mv$cor
cat("\nContributions of the variables\n")
mv$contrib
sink()

cls <- HCPC(mv, graph = F
            , nb.clust = -1
            , metric = "euclidean"
            , method = "ward"
            )

sink("files/hcpc.txt")
cat("\nHierarchical Clustering on Principal Components\n")
cls$call$t$tree
cls$desc.ind
cls$desc.var
sink()

map <- \() {plot(cls, choice = "map", draw.tree = FALSE)}
cir <- fviz_dend(cls, type = "circular", cex = 0.5)

plot <- list(map, cir) %>% 
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 2, labels = "auto") %>% 
  ggsave(plot = ., "manuscript/HCPC.jpg", units = "cm"
                , width = 30, height = 15)

plot %>% include_graphics()
```
